Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SolStream onboarding: invoice cutover, payment lane split & early pay exception

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — excited to get SolStream set up as a vendor. We're ready to submit the onboarding documents but ran into a couple of items that need alignment before we complete our AP configuration:

1) Invoice cutover date: our billing system closes on the 28th of the month. Can Redwood accept invoices with the 1st-of-month effective date for services delivered in the prior month?

2) Payment lanes: our procurement team needs our invoices routed to two different cost centers depending on product SKU (Platform services -> PO# 987654, Model Ops Consulting -> PO# 987655). Is a split-payment lane supported so Redwood can attach PO references to line items?

3) Early pay exception: we can offer a 1.25% early-pay discount if Redwood can remit within 10 business days. Our finance team asks whether Redwood has an early-disbursement path or if this needs special approval.

Attached: completed onboarding form, W-9, sample invoice.

We'd like to get the onboarding completed by end of next week to avoid delaying the May billing cycle. If you prefer, Maya (cc'd) can jump on a 20-min call to walk through the PO mapping.

Best,
Oliver Grant
VP Finance, SolStream Analytics
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: SolStream onboarding: invoice cutover, payment lane split & early pay exception

Hi Oliver — thanks for the details and the attachments. Welcome aboard. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) Invoice cutover: we can accept invoices dated 1st-of-month for the prior month as long as the invoice PDF includes the service period (e.g., 2028-03-01 to 2028-03-31). We'll add the cutover date to the vendor record so AP won't reject the first run.

2) Split payment lanes / PO mapping: we support line-level PO refs but need them defined in the PO creation process. Karthik (cc) handles PO routing — Karthik, can we create two child PO lines under the same master PO or should we issue separate POs for the two SKUs? 

3) Early pay: Monica, please advise on our early-disbursement program and what approval path is required for a 1.25% discount to net10. 

Operational asks from our side: we need the following from SolStream to finish setup:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we received, thanks)
- Company legal name and remit name (as it should appear on the check/ACH)
- Banking details for ACH (or indicate check-only) — we keep this in the secure vendor profile
- PO routing preference (single PO with line refs or two separate POs)

If it's easier, we can set a 20-min call tomorrow at 10am PT to map PO lanes.

Diego Fernandez
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <finance@solstream.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SolStream onboarding: invoice cutover, payment lane split & early pay exception

Hi all — looping in a couple notes from PO policy side.

- We prefer separate PO numbers per billing category to avoid GL mapping complexity. So please request PO 987654 (Platform) and PO 987655 (Consulting) as separate POs. Line-level refs are supported but historically introduce reconciliation friction for teams.

- On the early-pay ask: standard procurement approval for an early-pay discount under 1.5% can be approved by category managers; anything above 1.5% requires finance director sign-off. This one (1.25%) is within auto-approve band but we need vendor to opt into the Early Disbursement Program (EDP) in the vendor profile and provide ACH details. Kimberly from AP will coordinate the enrollment and the timing of the net10 payment.

Kimberly — can you confirm the timeline once the vendor is enrolled? Oliver, also confirm whether you prefer net10 vs net12 for the 1.25% offer.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Procurement Operations
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <finance@solstream.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 16:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SolStream onboarding: invoice cutover, payment lane split & early pay exception

Hi Oliver — quick operational update:

1) Enrollment: once we receive SolStream's banking details (ACH) and the vendor accepts the EDP terms (attached enrollment template), AP can schedule early disbursement. Typical enrollment turnaround is 3 business days after all docs are validated.

2) Timing: for invoices submitted by the 1st with the service period in the PDF, AP will process them under the new vendor record. For a net10 early pay option at 1.25%, Redwood will remit by the 10th business day following receipt of a valid invoice and will flag payments to your finance contact.

3) PO mapping: we will issue two POs (987654, 987655). Please include the relevant PO number on each invoice line. If you prefer a single invoice with two PO references, we will accept that but it will create an extra reconciliation step; please mark the invoice line items clearly.

Next steps for SolStream to finish onboarding:
- Reply to this thread with the legal remit name exactly as it appears on bank account
- Send ACH details or confirm check-only (ACH preferred for EDP)
- Review and sign the EDP enrollment template (I can send as DocuSign)

I'll send the enrollment template as a DocuSign link by EOD. Looking forward to getting you active for May billing.

Best,
Monica Patel
AP Manager | Redwood Inference
